name: WP AI Connect – Connect Claude & ChatGPT to WordPress
author: Hiren Patel

sections.description:
You already use AI to write and improve your content. WP AI Connect helps you put that work straight into WordPress.

Connect Claude or ChatGPT to your website, then ask it to create a draft, update a page, change an SEO description, or add a featured image. Spend less time copying text between tabs and finding the right settings.

Built by Satvik Infotech, WP AI Connect is a WordPress MCP connector for website owners, content teams, and agencies. You decide what your AI assistant can access and which changes it can make.

Everyday website updates, handled from your chat

Some tasks are easier to explain than to do manually. Try asking:

  • “Write a welcome post for our new service and save it as a draft.”
  • “Read our About page and suggest a clearer introduction before changing anything.”
  • “Update this post’s SEO title and meta description with the wording I’ve approved.”
  • “Upload this image and set it as the featured image for my latest draft.”
  • “Find our articles about dental implants and suggest which ones need a refresh.”

Your assistant can work with your website’s content, so you don’t have to paste everything into the conversation yourself. Available actions depend on the permissions you enable and the integrations installed on your site.

What you can do

Create and update content
Write drafts, edit existing posts and pages, and publish when publishing permission is enabled. Manage categories, tags, and comments from the same conversation.

Update SEO titles and descriptions
Work with supported Yoast SEO and Rank Math fields without opening each post’s SEO panel manually.

Manage images
Upload images from a supported URL to your Media Library and assign featured images to posts.

Work with Elementor content
Update supported Elementor page data and refresh its CSS cache. Check the resulting page layout after making changes.

Read and review your website
Use read-only access when you want your assistant to review content and suggest improvements without making changes.

Choose how much access to give

You don’t have to give your AI assistant full control of your website.

  • Start with the Read Only preset, or choose your own permissions.
  • Allow or restrict publishing, editing published content, and deleting content or media.
  • Set how long AI access stays active.
  • Review completed actions in the activity log.
  • Regenerate your connection link when you need to revoke the old link.

The assistant acts through a non-administrator WordPress user, and each action is checked against that user’s permissions. It cannot install plugins, switch themes, manage users, or edit your website’s code.

1,000 credits per month

WP AI Connect includes 1,000 credits per month for supported AI actions on your connected website.

You can check your usage and licence details in the plugin dashboard. Review the current plan details on our website before connecting.

Your chosen AI assistant’s account requirements and any separate subscription charges also apply.

Connect your preferred AI assistant

WP AI Connect works with Claude, ChatGPT, and other compatible assistants that support custom MCP connections.

MCP is the connection that lets your assistant work with WordPress. You don’t need to write code to use it.

Install the plugin, follow the connection instructions, choose your permissions, and try your first task. We suggest starting with a draft so you can review the result before publishing.

Need a hand?

Use the Support tab in the plugin dashboard or open a topic in the WordPress.org support forum. Tell us which assistant you’re using and where you got stuck so we can help you get connected.

WP AI Connect is developed by Satvik Infotech. It is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI or Anthropic.

External services

WP AI Connect is powered by a hosted service. We believe in being fully open about what is shared, so here are the details.

WP AI Connect hub (connect.satvikinfotech.com)

Provided by Satvik Infotech. The hub securely links your site with your AI assistant, handles Google sign-in, and manages your licence and usage. Nothing is sent until an administrator clicks “Agree & connect”.

After you agree, the following is shared:

  • Registration (when you agree, when you open the plugin’s settings page, and at most every 5 minutes while an administrator is using wp-admin): site URL, the site’s connection key, plugin version and edition.
  • Status, time-limited access and link resets (when you open the settings page or use these buttons): site URL and connection key.
  • Activity log (when AI performs an action): site URL and a short description of the action and its result, for example “Updated a post — completed”.
  • Error reports (when the plugin blocks a risky action or hits an error): site URL, the error message and plugin version.
  • Licence and access requests (when you enter a licence key, or approve or deny an access request): site URL, the licence key or email address entered, and your decision.
  • Uninstall (when the plugin is deleted): site URL and connection key, so the hub can remove your site’s records.

Your content only passes through the hub when your AI assistant reads or edits it at your request. Your database and passwords are never sent.

Terms of service: https://satvikinfotech.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://satvikinfotech.com/privacy

Your AI assistant

WP AI Connect is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic or OpenAI.

Claude (Anthropic), ChatGPT (OpenAI) and other assistants never connect to your site directly; they work through the hub. Content the AI reads or writes is processed by the AI provider you choose, under that provider’s own terms and privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins → Add New, search for “WP AI Connect”, then click Install Now and Activate.
    Or upload the satvik-ai-connect folder to /wp-content/plugins/ and activate it from the Plugins screen.
  2. Open WP AI Connect in the admin menu, read the short data notice and click Agree & connect.
  3. On the Permissions tab, choose the non-administrator user the AI acts as (or click Create a dedicated Editor account for the AI) and pick a preset or set your own permissions.
  4. On the Connect tab, choose how long AI access should last and click Activate access.
  5. Add your connection link to your AI assistant:
    • Claude: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector, then paste your link.
    • ChatGPT: turn on Developer Mode (Settings → Connectors → Advanced), then Add connector and paste your link.
  6. Sign in with Google when asked, and start chatting with your AI about your site.
sections.faq:
What does WP AI Connect do?

It connects your WordPress website to Claude, ChatGPT, or another compatible AI assistant. You can ask the assistant to read content, create drafts, edit pages, and perform supported SEO and media tasks within the permissions you allow.

Do I need coding experience?

No. Setup involves installing the plugin, choosing permissions, and adding a connection to your AI assistant. The plugin provides the connection details.

Does this add a chatbot to my website?

No. WP AI Connect helps you manage your website through your own AI assistant. It does not add a visitor-facing chat widget.

Can I review content before publishing?

Yes. You can ask your assistant to save new content as a draft and keep publishing permission disabled. Editing an already published page is a separate permission, so check that setting too.

Can I use it without allowing changes?

Yes. Choose the Read Only preset to let your assistant review accessible content without editing it.

Does it work with Yoast SEO and Rank Math?

Yes. WP AI Connect supports updating SEO titles and meta descriptions through its supported Yoast SEO and Rank Math integrations. The relevant SEO plugin must be installed and active.

Does it work with Elementor?

WP AI Connect supports updates to Elementor page data and can refresh the Elementor CSS cache. This does not mean every layout or third-party Elementor widget is supported. Preview affected pages after making changes.

How many credits are included?

WP AI Connect includes 1,000 credits per month. Check your dashboard for usage and your current plan details.

Do I need a Claude or ChatGPT account?

Yes. You need an account with an AI assistant that supports the required custom connection. Available features and subscription requirements depend on that provider.

Can the assistant install plugins or change my website’s code?

No. WP AI Connect is designed for content-related work. The assistant cannot manage users, install plugins, switch themes, or edit website code.

Does my content pass through an external service?

Yes. WP AI Connect uses a hosted hub operated by Satvik Infotech to connect your website and AI assistant. Content requested or changed by your assistant passes through that hub and is processed by your chosen AI provider. See the External Services section for details.

How do I stop access?

You can let the access period expire, regenerate your connection link to invalidate the old one, or deactivate the plugin.
sections.changelog:
1.0.5

  • Clearer connection screen: one plain-language disclosure of exactly what connecting sends, with a “Full privacy terms” view. Clicking “Agree & connect” is your consent.
  • Privacy: the plugin no longer collects administrator names/emails or environment/telemetry data. Only the data needed to run the connection is sent.

1.0.4

  • New name: the plugin is now “WP AI Connect – Connect Claude & ChatGPT to WordPress”. Same plugin, same settings.
  • Added Ripal Patel (@hikebranding) as a contributor.
  • Refreshed the plugin description and listing details.

1.0.3

  • Fix: the Trial ends date is now shown on the Connect tab (one month after the trial starts).

1.0.2

  • The plugin is now called WP AI Connect by Satvik Infotech. No functional changes.

1.0.1

  • Minor: the plugin now reports its edition when connecting, so the hub recognises the site correctly.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: connect Claude, ChatGPT and other AI assistants to WordPress with content-only access, permission presets, time-limited access, a safety guard and an activity log.
